product.olivetti-laptop-d33.summary: The highest-clocked portable in the September 1991 Olivetti 1. catalogue.
product.olivetti-laptop-d33.history: In September 1991 Olivetti offered the Laptop D33 in the Olivetti 1. line. The Historical Archive attributes development of the range to Triumph-Adler with Y-E Data collaboration and locates production in Nuremberg.
product.olivetti-laptop-d33.architecture: The format explains the differences in weight and expansion. The catalogue specifies 5 kg and 386 × 300 × 61 mm, with an integrated mouse and 1.44 MB floppy drive.
product.olivetti-laptop-d33.verified: The configuration was checked against the cited sources. BluMach validation is pending.
product.olivetti-laptop-d33.limitations: Firmware verification, boot tests and a photograph with clear publication rights are pending.
